11coors: Ulrich "Whistle" Coors arrived at V-F2 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Ulrich "Whistle" Coors. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.
Otto "Whistle" Scp (Hegemony) watched Ulrich "Whistle" Coors (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Hanging Bridge, and held fire until both were gone.
The rain did not stop once. Ulrich "Whistle" Coors slept standing up, wedged against the wall of V-F2, and dreamt of dry socks.
allenbowles28: Silas Allenbowles came up on Day 10 carrying news from Tannenfeld. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. Orders assigned Silas Allenbowles to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

Silas Allenbowles agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Silas Allenbowles watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Silas Allenbowles found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Silas Allenbowles was faster. Felix Mply was grazed.

Silas Allenbowles went out with the wiring party at U-F4. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Two shots, one miss. The second found Cyril Roland, grazed. Silas Allenbowles cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Allenbowles. Silas Allenbowles read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The artist tried again while Silas Allenbowles read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
The raid was quick, the way back was not. Silas Allenbowles snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Silas Allenbowles free.
badbadmannnn: The sergeant gave Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 7 or any other.
Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn saved the last of the sugar for Otto "Parson" Vicious's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Parson's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
The promotion to Lance Corporal reached Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn on a creased slip of paper. He smoothed it and put it with the letters from home.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-S5 changed before the cheering ended. Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn shouldered another load.

A bullet hit Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn's belt buckle at S-S5 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple of the Concord (@kamdensipple). The clerk counted the names twice. Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn is number 481 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill has been won. Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
The medic looked at Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-S5. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.

The whole squad at S-S5 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn's bullet that found Edmund "Ash" Yer, grazed. Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn was found at the bottom of the trench at S-S5, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Gideon Wolves of the Concord (@living_with_wild_wolves). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn fell at S-S5 and never moved again. Shot by Gideon Wolves of the Concord (@living_with_wild_wolves).
Marek Badbadmannnn took the same post at S-S5 where Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
A letter reached Marek Badbadmannnn from Northwick. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one.
Marek Badbadmannnn offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
The telephone went dead during the shelling. Marek Badbadmannnn watched the runner leave with the written orders, then listened for the phone to ring again.
carson._.bloom: On Day 9, Oskar "Mole" Bloom arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Oskar "Mole" Bloom was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-C12 changed before the cheering ended. Oskar "Mole" Bloom shouldered another load.
There was no room for Oskar "Mole" Bloom. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.

The House of Bloom sent another. Bastian Bloom, cousin of Oskar "Mole" Bloom, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. The clerk counted the names twice. Bastian Bloom is number 941 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Bastian Bloom during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Bastian Bloom put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Bastian Bloom changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Bastian Bloom spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
Bastian Bloom fixed the strap on Otto "Crow" Erenn's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.

Bastian Bloom went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Concord trench Teodor Triplejjj put up a fight, but not for long. (@dj_triplejjj1120) Bastian Bloom made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Bastian Bloom crawled the last yards.
christopher.holt.9083: The draft reached S-C8 on Day 9. Dietrich Holt was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Dietrich Holt folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Dietrich Holt's bunk. He has named it Margarethe. The clerk counted the names twice. Dietrich Holt is number 741 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Dietrich Holt did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
The cook's fire went out. Dietrich Holt relit it under his own coat and served stew that tasted of wool.
Margarethe the rat now waits for Dietrich Holt at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.
Dietrich Holt took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.
Across the wire at Hill 304, Karel Jonas of the Concord held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Dietrich Holt of the Hegemony held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.'
Margarethe ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Dietrich Holt followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Margarethe his life.
clarke_070: On the way to U-F10, Gustav Clarke tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Gustav Clarke fished it out by feel and then had to wash again. A letter from home found Gustav Clarke before the night shift. Gustav Clarke folded it small and kept it close. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Gustav Clarke read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at U-F10 and grazed Gustav Clarke's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Teodor Fleming of the Hegemony (@lachie_fleming1).

Gustav Clarke walked back up the communication trench to U-F10, slower than before, but on his own feet. A letter from home found Gustav Clarke before the night shift. Gustav Clarke folded it small and kept it close. Gustav Clarke's transfer to the role of rifleman was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet hit Gustav Clarke's belt buckle at U-F10 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. A letter from home found Gustav Clarke before the night shift. Gustav Clarke folded it small and kept it close.

The medics cleaned Gustav Clarke's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at U-F10. A letter from home found Gustav Clarke before the night shift. Gustav Clarke folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet went through Gustav Clarke's sleeve at U-F10 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Hugo Suzumi of the Hegemony (@me._.suzumi). Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Clarke. Gustav Clarke read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
connor_allphin: The new rifleman gave his name as Karel Allphin. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Karel Allphin wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Karel Allphin drew the street leading to Esterhaus. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Karel Allphin answered to number 642. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-C9. Karel Allphin has learned to walk bent double.
Karel Allphin offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
A round went through the rim of Karel Allphin's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Felix Jakub of the Hegemony (@j_ak_u_b1).
Karel Allphin rejoined the squad at S-C9. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Karel Allphin brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
Karel Allphin borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
cutrate_cowboy: Bram Cowboy unpacked a photograph gone soft at the edges at Q-F6. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Bram Cowboy saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram Cowboy. Bram Cowboy read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Bram Cowboy folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Bram Cowboy tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram Cowboy. Bram Cowboy read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Bram Cowboy wrote a letter for Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk's mother, because Ghost could not find the words. Ghost signed it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram Cowboy. Bram Cowboy read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Bram Cowboy was asked to arrange a gathering for men who did not want a sermon. He asked what they did want and wrote down the answers.

Bram Cowboy owes Matthias Wasdwizard so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram Cowboy. Bram Cowboy read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet went through Bram Cowboy's upper arm at Q-F6 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Valentin Dutch of the Concord (@dutch_1996). Bram Cowboy was hit at Q-F6 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Valentin Dutch of the Concord (@dutch_1996).
The House of Cowboy sent another. Silas Cowboy, cousin of Bram Cowboy, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
emelryk_senpai: The old hands of N-F14 have been here since Day 1. Gideon Senpai has been here since Day 11. In a trench, that difference already feels like years. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Gideon Senpai wrote to an old father who runs the family shop alone that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A newspaper reached Gideon Senpai with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.

At N-F14 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Gideon Senpai won the bet. Emil Banter was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon Senpai. Gideon Senpai read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gideon Senpai crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at N-F14 holds again. Gideon Senpai left the work of a rifleman to become a sniper. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

Gideon Senpai fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Severin Claymcc was badly wounded. Gideon Senpai ate breakfast without a word. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon Senpai. Gideon Senpai read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Gideon Senpai only heard boots on the duckboards at N-F14, then nothing but pain. Raider: Hugo Rambo of the Hegemony (@burger_rambo). Gideon Senpai came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot.
evanrobinson4578: Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson came up on Day 9 carrying news from Tannenfeld. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson taught Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips three words in the language of home. Brick uses all three at the wrong moment, every day. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into U-F12. Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson has learned to walk bent double.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at U-F12 and grazed Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Cyril Drawtoss of the Hegemony (@drawtoss).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.
The sergeant at U-F12 called out a range and a spot. Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson was the only one who hit it. Isidor "Rabbit" Png was grazed.
Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson drew the street leading to Tannenfeld. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.
frederikgejlmadsen: Jonas Frederikgejl arrived on Day 10 as a replacement. The men in U-F9 had been fighting for 10 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Jonas Frederikgejl added a leak above the man's head in pencil. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Jonas Frederikgejl shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Jonas Frederikgejl and Dorian "Saint" Dallas spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
Emil Czucha and Jonas Frederikgejl compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Jonas Frederikgejl got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
For keeping his head when others lost theirs at the Sunken Road, Jonas Frederikgejl was promoted to Lance Corporal.
Jonas Frederikgejl and Emil Czucha divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
goodnametaken1: Nils Goodnametake joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Nils Goodnametake looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Nils Goodnametake started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here." From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Nils Goodnametake wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Nils Goodnametake kept Gideon Green awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Nils could have walked there blind.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Nils Goodnametake has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
Nils Goodnametake's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point."
Nils Goodnametake and Gideon Green compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
The trench wall shook against Nils Goodnametake's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
imarcomaldonado: The sergeant gave Zeno "Crow" Imarcomaldon a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 10 or any other.

A recruit asked Zeno "Crow" Imarcomaldon how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In U-F14, Zeno "Crow" Imarcomaldon listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A round came through the loophole Zeno "Crow" Imarcomaldon was watching at U-F14 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Quentin Caeleboldake of the Hegemony (@caeleboldaker).
Zeno "Crow" Imarcomaldon lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
Zeno "Crow" Imarcomaldon returned to U-F14 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
Zeno "Crow" Imarcomaldon and the recruit have reached whole words. Lessons take place beside the stove, with spelling corrections from people pretending not to listen.

A bullet struck Zeno "Crow" Imarcomaldon below the ribs at U-F14. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Teodor Redflamesofs of the Hegemony (@redflamesofsteel). A single shot at U-F14. Zeno "Crow" Imarcomaldon sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Teodor Redflamesofs of the Hegemony (@redflamesofsteel).
Jonas Imarcomaldon asked about Zeno "Crow" Imarcomaldon on arriving at U-F14. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
jordan_cas88: The new sniper is Zeno Cas, once a carpenter from Esterhaus. The corporal asked if a carpenter was any use in a trench. Zeno Cas said he would find out.

Zeno Cas got a letter from Clara. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into P-F1. Zeno Cas has learned to walk bent double.
Zeno Cas went out with a patrol to the Sunken Road and did not come back with it. He is listed as missing. The men leave his rations untouched.
Someone at P-F1 saved Zeno Cas's share of the rations. Nobody said why.
The squad at P-F1 still leaves a gap on the fire step where Zeno Cas used to stand.
No word on Zeno Cas. A runner went to ask in the next sector and came back with nothing.
Zeno Cas turned up at a neighbouring battalion, having walked the wrong way for a day and a half. He came home to P-F1 with three new friends and no explanation.
just_mas0: Nils Mas arrived with the Day 5 draft, carrying a letter he never sent and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Nils Mas ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F21. Nils Mas has learned to walk bent double.
Nils Mas fired at a movement across the wire at S-F21. The man went down: Walter Juizy, grazed.
Nils Mas spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.
Nils Mas raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F21. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Leopold Staryfins of the Hegemony (@staryfins).

Nils Mas was carrying water up to S-F21 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Nils Mas did not. Shot by Dorian Robertoneill of the Hegemony (@robertoneill2008). Nils Mas stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-F21. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Dorian Robertoneill of the Hegemony (@robertoneill2008).
Casimir "Owl" Mas put a letter he never sent beside the bunk. Someone who had known Nils Mas helped clear the shelf without saying why.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Casimir "Owl" Mas watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Casimir "Owl" Mas took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-F21, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Quentin Dorufotograf of the Hegemony (@dorufotograful). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Casimir "Owl" Mas answered to number 342. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Casimir "Owl" Mas watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
No bed, no surgeon, just a medic with a kit and a lot of patience. Casimir "Owl" Mas recovered anyway and is back at S-F21.
Casimir "Owl" Mas saved the last of the sugar for Dorian Noahz's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Dorian's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael stood up to sing louder, and Casimir "Owl" Mas fired. Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael was grazed. The singing stopped.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F21 and grazed Casimir "Owl" Mas's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Zeno "Mud" Jwger of the Hegemony (@jwger87).

A round came through the loophole Casimir "Owl" Mas was watching at S-F21 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael of the Hegemony (@elbert_nathanael).
keremuraz37: Oskar Keremuraz arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Oskar Keremuraz did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Oskar Keremuraz spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Oskar Keremuraz is number 608. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Oskar Keremuraz during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Oskar Keremuraz and Nils Lettersupona have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
Oskar Keremuraz measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
Oskar Keremuraz tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Oskar Keremuraz left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.
The recruit sat beside Oskar Keremuraz at supper but left before the talk began. Oskar Keremuraz passed the bread without trying to start a conversation.
ojmcfall: Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall unpacked a book with the last pages torn out at S-S2. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall held the mirror while Marek Janzhhhhhhhh shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-S2 with the rations. Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall ate while listening to the revised orders.

Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall is number 552. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
A stretcher party needed the passage. Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall backed into a recess with an ammunition box and stayed there until the last bearer passed.
Word of Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Dorian Caleb, grazed.
Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall finished the blanket using six kinds of cloth. The men can identify most of the donors by the patches alone.
A bullet went through Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall's sleeve at S-S2 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Oskar Londonz of the Hegemony (@londonz_29).
phs_jrotc_drill_team: Nobody asked Emil "Mud" Team why he came. Nobody in S-S9 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
A direct hit on the trench at S-S9. Emil "Mud" Team was the only one they could still help, and only just. Emil "Mud" Team died at his post at S-S9 when the dugout roof came down under a direct hit.

Florian Team took the same post at S-S9 where Emil "Mud" Team stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Florian Team shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Florian Team traded a pressed cornflower for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Florian Team put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Florian Team won before reaching the end of his entry.
Florian Team washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.

Fresh from training, Florian Team still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Gideon Dominicktheb, grazed. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Florian Team watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Florian Team was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-S9. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Bram Kochek of the Concord (@thicc_kochek). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Florian Team is number 344. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Florian Team could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Machine-gun fire swept S-S9. Florian Team took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Emil "Brick" Xavidonegan of the Concord (@xavidonegan). Florian Team was killed on watch at S-S9. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Emil "Brick" Xavidonegan of the Concord (@xavidonegan).
Teodor Team put a pressed cornflower beside the bunk. Someone who had known Florian Team helped clear the shelf without saying why.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Teodor Team was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Teodor Team brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load.

Teodor Team was carrying water up to S-S9 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Teodor Team did not. Shot by Zeno "Shadow" Maximus of the Concord (@sleetius_maximus). Teodor Team was killed outright at S-S9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Zeno "Shadow" Maximus of the Concord (@sleetius_maximus).
Jonas Team arrived carrying the family name of Teodor Team. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

A bullet struck Jonas Team below the ribs at S-S9. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Walter Nightrunner of the Concord (@nightrunner289). There was no room for Jonas Team. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
The papers connected Viktor Team to Jonas Team. The men took longer to learn Viktor Team's own habits, but they made the effort.
plhubs: Hugo Plhubs, a farmhand from Wyvern Cross, was sent forward on Day 11 to fill a gap in P-F19. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Hugo Plhubs could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Across from P-F19, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Hugo Plhubs saw it. Arno Pars was grazed.
Hugo Plhubs borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.

A dog crosses no man's land at Grey Mill every night, fed by Felix Barringarms on one side and Hugo Plhubs on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy. Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Plhubs. Hugo Plhubs read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Hugo Plhubs. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.

Hugo Plhubs took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Jonas Dalton, badly wounded. A bullet went through Hugo Plhubs's upper arm at P-F19 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Tobias "Crow" Straitonjosh of the Concord (@straitonjosh). The bearers set Hugo Plhubs's stretcher down under a tarp and promised to come back. They came back with another man.
ritualforsam_26: Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-C11 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home reached Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam before dusk. Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam read it twice and slept a little easier.

Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam answered to number 626. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Konrad Zdsh, was gravely wounded. Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-C11. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Norbert Fransinlak of the Hegemony (@fransinlak). Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-C11. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Norbert Fransinlak of the Hegemony (@fransinlak).
The papers connected Karel Ritualforsam to Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam. The men took longer to learn Karel Ritualforsam's own habits, but they made the effort.
A bullet went through Karel Ritualforsam's sleeve at S-C11 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Matthias "Saint" Mulletoperat of the Hegemony (@mulletoperator).
Karel Ritualforsam no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
On dawn watch at S-C11, Karel Ritualforsam fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Roland Theelliottma, now badly wounded.

The barrage caught Karel Ritualforsam in the open at S-C11. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. Nobody could reach Karel Ritualforsam in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.
Nils Ritualforsam took the same post at S-C11 where Karel Ritualforsam stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
rjk7747: On Day 10, Albin Rjk arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

A letter reached Albin Rjk from Marrow Fen. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Rjk. Albin Rjk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Albin Rjk watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Albin Rjk shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Bram Simone, was gravely wounded.
Albin Rjk watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Albin Rjk tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at U-F22 is up. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Rjk. Albin Rjk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Albin Rjk held the mirror while Bastian Xakhariash shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.

The old Private did not come back from the wire. Albin Rjk wears his stripes now: Lance Corporal. A letter reached Albin Rjk with a child's drawing of a soldier. The soldier in the drawing was smiling. Albin Rjk tried to as well.
slow_lx: The sergeant gave Karel Slow a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 10 or any other.

The bread had frozen at the edges. Karel Slow held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Karel Slow looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Karel Slow hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
Isidor "Hollow" Horror gave Karel Slow the last match in the trench. Karel used it to light a candle so that Hollow could finish a letter.
Karel Slow wrote a letter for Pavel "Tin" Jacob's mother, because Tin could not find the words. Tin signed it.
A bullet grazed Karel Slow's ribs at U-F1. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Cyril "Spark" Evader of the Hegemony (@mr._tax_evader).
Back on the fire step at U-F1. Karel Slow says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
tadzyman: Silas Tadzyman told the sergeant he was a printer's apprentice. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Silas Tadzyman helped stack spare sandbags at R-R15. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Silas Tadzyman and Bastian "Mud" Decybecy made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Tadzyman. Silas Tadzyman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Silas Tadzyman answered to number 946. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Silas Tadzyman read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A bullet went through Silas Tadzyman's sleeve at R-R15 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Zeno Irl of the Hegemony (@king_baldwin_irl). Silas Tadzyman fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Nils Snelling, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Silas Tadzyman returned to R-R15 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
A clear shot from R-R15. Silas Tadzyman grazed Benedikt Datoneperson and slid back down below the parapet.
A round went through Silas Tadzyman's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Anselm "Lucky" Kevinrey of the Hegemony (@kevinrey007).
Silas Tadzyman came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
urfavv__j: Oskar Urfavv came up on Day 7 carrying news from Ashford Vale. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Oskar Urfavv of the Concord shouted a joke across the wire at the Chalk Pits. Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga of the Hegemony laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.
Oskar Urfavv (Concord) and Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher (Hegemony) watched each other through the same loophole at the Brickworks for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.

Oskar Urfavv fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-S13. Norbert "Ghost" Ayers was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Oskar Urfavv wrote to a girl from the dance hall, maybe that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Oskar Urfavv fired at a movement across the wire at S-S13. The man went down: Ulrich Nothing, badly wounded. The clerk counted the names twice. Oskar Urfavv is number 501 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Oskar Urfavv looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Oskar Urfavv sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
Oskar Urfavv had Wendel Jesus of the Hegemony in the sights at Blackwater Canal for a long second. Wendel Jesus was lighting a pipe. Oskar Urfavv let the match burn all the way down.
Oskar Urfavv began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
Oskar Urfavv did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Oskar Urfavv fired back. Florian Carterdelaru was badly wounded.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Oskar Urfavv fired, and Zeno Ramsey was badly wounded.
whoa_darryl: Henrik Darryl arrived on Day 10 as a replacement. The men in P-F21 had been fighting for 10 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Henrik Darryl found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Henrik Darryl looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Henrik Darryl tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper.
Henrik Darryl's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
Henrik Darryl fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Jakub "Owl" Wmacdon, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
The shelling stopped while Henrik Darryl was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.

Henrik Darryl counted the steps of the Hegemony sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Otto Chuckemuckle never saw the shovel coming. (@chuckemuckle) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Henrik Darryl snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Henrik Darryl free.
xdissonvncex: Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in T-F13 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex fired, and Viktor Pauar was grazed. News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F13 with the rations. Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex ate while listening to the revised orders.

Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex reached up to fix a sandbag at T-F13 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Severin Drowning of the Hegemony (@drowning.in._). Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Konrad Irl was badly wounded. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at T-F13 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex's bunk. He has named it Napoleon.
Napoleon the rat now waits for Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.
Dawn watch. Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Roland Light, grazed.
